item.title: Harness Engineering Course
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Harness Engineering Course
https://github.com/walkinglabs/learn-harness-engineering

Harness Engineering course on GitHub with 14 lectures + 8 hands-on projects. it covers:

how Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek build their harness
loop & graph engineering
automated agent loops
observability, testing and verification
really good source for learning harness essentials by doing.

Ref: https://x.com/i/status/2105980972558627237
